tool_input.message:
Done. Commit 954b63c on fix/poll-intervals, internal/mcp/poll_tools_test.go only (no helper file needed — newMarkerServer already takes t, so I registered the cleanup there directly).

(1) Poller leak: added `t.Cleanup(poller.Stop)` right after NewPoller in newMarkerServer, with a comment on why (set_poll_interval starts the background goroutine; without stopping it, it outlives the fixture teardown and hits closed connections). Stop() is a safe no-op for tests that never call set_poll_interval.
Proof: `go test -race -count=1 -run TestSetPollInterval_AcceptsEveryValidInterval -v ./internal/mcp/` — all 9 subtests PASS, no goroutine-leak warnings, no "use of closed" errors. I also confirmed this was a real silent leak (not just a cosmetic fix) by stashing the fix and re-running the same test: it still PASSed, because nothing asserted against the leak directly — exactly the silent-failure shape the finding described.

(2) cronExpr 45m bug: added `&& 60%int(d/time.Minute) == 0` to the first case, so a sub-hour duration that doesn't evenly divide 60 (45m fires at :00/:45 — 15 min then 45 min apart, not every 45) now falls through to t.Fatalf instead of emitting a wrong "*/45 * * * *". Updated the doc comment to explain why.
Proof, scratch copy under .tmp/ (deleted after): added "45m": 45*time.Minute to validPollIntervals and a tiny throwaway test file calling cronExpr(t, "45m") directly. Output:
  cronexpr_fidelity_test.go:6: interval "45m" (45m0s) has no known cron-expression shape; extend cronExpr
  --- FAIL: TestFidelityCronExpr45m (0.00s)

Gate: go build clean, go test -race -count=1 ./internal/mcp/ ok, then full `make check` green — shellcheck, go vet, staticcheck, golangci-lint (0 issues), govulncheck, markdownlint (0 issues), go test -race -count=1 ./... ok across every package (internal/daemon 11.8s, internal/pgp 19.5s included).

Not pushed, no PR touched.

tool_input.prompt: Review commit 954b63c in the beadle Go repo: `git -C <repo> show 954b63c`. It answers three PR review threads on internal/mcp/poll_tools_test.go: (a) TestSetPollInterval_AcceptsEveryValidInterval started a poller per subtest via set_poll_interval and never stopped it, leaking goroutines past fixture teardown; the fix should route through setupHandlerWithPoller(t) or register t.Cleanup(poller.Stop) before the fixture's cleanup; (b) cronExpr accepted "*/N * * * *" for any N under 60 without requiring 60%N==0. Verify: run `go -C <repo> test -race -count=3 -run TestSetPollInterval_AcceptsEveryValidInterval -v ./internal/mcp/` and confirm no leak warnings, no "use of closed" errors, and that cleanup order means Stop runs before the IMAP fixture closes (read the helper); confirm the 60-divisor check falls through to t.Fatalf for 45m; check whether the change weakened any assertion or skipped any interval. Report findings with file:line; if none, say so explicitly. Do not edit files.
